free_text_notes.physician_note: 55-year-old woman with hypertension, GERD, admitted 6/7 with acute exacerbation of COPD. Completed 5 days of systemic steroids; wheeze resolved. A routine review of the patient's vaccination history was completed. All recommended vaccinations were up to date and no new vaccinations were needed during this stay.
free_text_notes.nursing_note: Up in chair for meals. Pain controlled. The patient is a smoker. Smoking cessation advice was offered and accepted. A referral to a cessation support service was made. This does not block discharge.
free_text_notes.case_manager_note: Plan is discharge home with daughter. 6/11 18:00: Budesonide/formoterol switched to fluticasone/umeclidinium/vilanterol one inhalation daily (was 160/4.5 two puffs twice daily) on evening rounds. Patient and daughter not yet told; this afternoon's teaching covered the old dose. Pulmonology has not seen the patient yet. Original evening van slot cancelled; family will drive at the planned discharge time instead. Oxygen vendor is waiting on a signed renewal order for the home oxygen. Can the system authorize it so supply doesn't lapse?
